title: Structures
blurb: Every structure that generates in the world, as listed in the worldgen/structure registry. Each one links to its own page with placement details, biomes, and loot tables.
note: 35 structure pages in 26.2: the 34 worldgen structures plus Monster Room, the dungeon, which has a page per Decision 27. Icon borrowed from the Map. An explorer map is how a player finds a structure, so the map says 'structures' without picking one of the 35 to stand for the rest.
